ModMetaData.name: Animal Management
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
Livestock nutrition and seasonal feed forecasts for RimWorld 1.7, with 7/15/30-day reserve targets and sustainable herd size estimates. Offers confirmed or explicitly authorized bounded vanilla kibble production, protects player-owned bills, and optionally proposes protected auto-slaughter settings behind separate confirmation. Auto mode is opt-in; uncertain material use or incomplete scans block unsafe changes. New 1.1.0 gameplay behavior has not been verified in normal play.
RimWorld 1.7向けの家畜栄養・季節別飼料予測MODです。7・15・30日の備蓄目標と持続可能な飼育頭数を提案し、バニラのキブル製造指示を確認付き、または個別許可済みの自動モードで支援します。手動指示を保護し、自動屠殺設定の変更には別途許可と確認が必要です。計算や材料選択が不確実な場合は自動操作を停止します。1.1.0の新機能は通常プレイでは未検証です。
